name: pocotoko-search
description: Optional local keyword search over a project's notes and docs.

projects.title: Projects to search
projects.description: Absolute folder paths that search is turned on for. Only an exact real-path match enables a project.

matching.title: Matching level
matching.description: exact matches whole words only. broad also matches word families, prefixes, near spellings and synonyms. Any other value means broad.

word_families.title: Word families
word_families.description: english treats plural and other common word forms as one word. off turns that matching off. Any other value means english.

extra_types.title: Extra file types
extra_types.description: Extra file extensions to index. The built-in never-list still applies.

never_folders.title: Never-search folders
never_folders.description: Folders to skip. This can only narrow what is indexed.

never_globs.title: Never-search patterns
never_globs.description: File patterns to skip. This can only narrow what is indexed.

never_terms.title: Never-index terms
never_terms.description: Terms that cause a chunk of text to be dropped. This can only narrow what is indexed.

synonyms.title: Synonym groups
synonyms.description: One group per entry, written term=alt|alt. One-way: a search for the term also looks for its alternatives. No commas inside an entry.

drop_contacts.title: Drop contact details
drop_contacts.description: Drop text chunks that hold email addresses or phone numbers.

max_file_bytes.title: Largest file size
max_file_bytes.description: Largest file, in bytes, that is indexed. Kept between 1024 and 4194304.

node_path.title: Node program
node_path.description: The Node program used to launch the search server. An absolute path to a real Node program is the safe setting on Windows. The default is node.
